---
title: "Caption layout"
format: typst
filters:
  - index
---

The fixture for a mark in the caption of a float that Quarto lays out in
cells, or that a code cell writes (M115 review). The filter moves a caption's
labels into the content of a float whose content is one paragraph, table or
code block, so that a Typst list of figures does not copy them. It leaves any
other float's content as it is, because each change to such content changed
Quarto's layout: a wrapper made two cells one, a label joined to an image's
cell kept a width Quarto drops there, and a wrapper around a code cell's
output moved the figure to the margin. So the two text cells below print side
by side, on one line of text, and the figures on the next two pages print as
the same figures with no mark print beside them. Each mark files its own page.

A figure in the shape a code cell writes, its one block the cell's output div,
which Quarto unwraps when it is the figure's whole content. A wrapper around it
stopped that, and the figure printed at the left margin. It must print where
the same figure with no mark, below it, prints.
